app.bootingHint: Connecting to MCP servers may take a while

titleBar.ordinanceTitle: Village ordinance (rules shared by all servants)

settings.title: System settings
settings.villageScope: This setting is stored in the village configuration (world.json), so it travels with the village when you share it.

tokenBudget.heading: Token limit (effective tokens)
tokenBudget.help: The sum of uncached ×1 + cached ×0.1 + output ×4. Managed internally in milli units; displayed as a rounded-up integer. When a single request's token spend reaches this value, the request is cut off automatically.
tokenBudget.invalid: Enter an integer of 1 or more (0 cannot remove the limit — choose "No limit" instead).
tokenBudget.guideline: Guide: village of ~6 = 1,000,000 / 12-servant scale or output-heavy code generation = 2,000,000–3,000,000
tokenBudget.noCeilingWarning: In a village without a limit, a single request keeps burning tokens when a failure loop occurs. Setting a limit is recommended.
tokenBudget.saved: Saved. Takes effect from the next request (no restart needed).

language.heading: Language
language.help: Display language of the UI. The switch takes effect the moment you save.
language.promptNote: Instructions to servants (system prompts and tool descriptions) are not translated — translating them would change the prompts. System lines in the conversation log stay in the language they were written in.

messages.heading: Message visibility
messages.intro: Confirmations and notices that can be suppressed are collected here.
messages.instantNote: Changes are saved immediately, on this machine only (not part of the village configuration).

edgeDelete.heading: Deleting a connection (edge)
edgeDelete.intro: On the village map, clicking a connection (edge) deletes it. Connections cannot be restored.
edgeDelete.checkbox: Show a confirmation dialog before deleting
edgeDelete.offWarning: While confirmation is off, a single click on an edge removes the connection.

grounding.heading: Grounding
grounding.sourcesMissing: No sources were returned (URLs in the reply are not confirmed citations).

agentList.heading: Servants
agentList.batchAllTransitioning: All targets are currently changing state
agentList.batchNoTargets: No servants are selected for batch start (choose with the toggle on each card)
agentList.noTemplates: No model templates are registered. Register one first via the "Manage model templates" button above.
agentList.emptyLine2: Add one with the + button in the top right.

agentCard.batchIncluded: Included in batch start (▶). Click to exclude
agentCard.batchExcluded: Excluded from batch start (▶). Click to include
agentCard.cacheDetail: Total {total} ({input} input / {output} output; output is {outputShare}% of the total). {cached} of the input tokens were read from the prompt cache. Output cannot be cached, so the rate is relative to input (0% means the cache is not being hit)

chatInput.hint: Enter to send / Shift+Enter for a new line

bottomTabs.blackboardTitle: The village blackboard (shared working notes). Shows the 黒板/ folder under work_dir; nothing can be written from here
bottomTabs.wavesTitle: Execution traces of plan. Columns = waves / rows = servants

blackboard.refreshTitle: Reload the blackboard (it also refreshes automatically while shown)
blackboard.empty: Nothing has been written on the blackboard yet (notes placed in the 黒板/ folder under work_dir will appear here).

map.heading: Village map
map.headingHelp: Drag a handle to connect / click an edge to disconnect (a bidirectional edge cuts both directions)
map.bidirectionalNote: This is a bidirectional connection, so both directions will be cut.

chat.heading: Chat
chat.newChatTitle: Close this conversation and start a new one (the previous conversation is saved and can be reopened from the session list)
chat.newChatConfirmTitle: Close this conversation and start a new one?
chat.newChatConfirmMessage: The current conversation is saved, and you can return to it anytime from Sessions.
chat.sessionsTitle: Saved conversations. Reopen, fork, export, or delete
chat.summarizeTitle: Summarizes the conversation so far to shorten future prompts (applies to running servants; uses tokens; the original exchanges are not lost)
chat.summarizeConfirmTitle: Summarize the conversation so far and continue?
chat.summarizeConfirmMessage:
This calls the model once per running servant, so it uses tokens (stopped servants are skipped).
The original exchanges are not lost (you can read them via the export in Sessions).
chat.interruptAllTitle: Interrupts all in-flight turns (servants stay running; the conversation and history are kept)
chat.interruptTurnTitle: Interrupts {name}'s current turn (the servant stays running; the conversation and history are kept)
chat.interruptPending: Stop requested… (it will stop once the current operation finishes)

editor.mcpPlaceholder: JSON in the same mcpServers format as Claude Desktop. Leave it empty if this servant has no dedicated MCP. Broken JSON cannot be saved.
editor.markdownPlaceholder: Written in Markdown. If you save it empty, this section is not included in the prompt.
editor.discardSwitchMessage: Your edits will not be saved.

ordinance.title: Village Ordinance
ordinance.discardCloseMessage: Your edits to the ordinance will not be saved.
ordinance.description: These are {rules}. They sit at the top of every servant's system prompt (above individual settings) and take effect from the next message after saving. You can also write shared rules here to even out behavioral differences between models.
ordinance.descriptionRules: rules that apply to every servant in this village
ordinance.placeholder:
Example:
This is Outcasts Village.
- Value implementation details and verifiable claims over vague impressions
- End the conversation rather than repeating what someone said
- Polite but frank; no flattery

mcp.title: MCP Servers
mcp.discardCloseMessage: Your edits will not be saved.
mcp.description: Connect external tools via {mcp} (Model Context Protocol). The format is {sameAs}, so you can paste an existing configuration {asIs} (commands such as `npx` are resolved from PATH). Saving reconnects immediately, and each servant can use the tools from its next message. {secrets} — this file is stored in plain text.
mcp.descriptionSecrets: Do not write secrets such as API keys here
mcp.editorPlaceholder: (not configured) Start from the Example button at the top right
mcp.saveNote: Saving reconnects the servers (no app restart needed)

uiErrors.canvasContext: Could not get a canvas 2D context

agentSettings.openFolderFailed: Could not open the configuration folder
agentSettings.iconHint: Pick a png / jpg and it will be converted to WebP and saved.
agentSettings.iconRemoveMessage: The avatar reverts to the round initial.
agentSettings.name: Name
agentSettings.workDir: Working folder (search scope for grep / diff)
agentSettings.workDirPlaceholder: e.g. D:\Projects\my-app (tools stay inactive until set)
agentSettings.workDirHint: Bundled tools can read only inside this folder. Do not point it at folders containing secrets.
agentSettings.maxToolsHint: How many tool calls one response may use. For research-heavy coding servants, raising it to 12–20 makes truncation less likely (at the cost of more tokens).
agentSettings.toolsDefault: Default (all; new tools are added automatically)
agentSettings.noWorkDirWarn: No working folder is set, so file tools are not offered (your checkmarks are kept).
agentSettings.rememberOffWarn: Unchecking remember stops long-term memory from updating itself (Memory.md is still loaded).
agentSettings.hearsRoomLogHint: Conversations between other servants will no longer be available as context (this saves tokens). This servant's own remarks are still heard by the others as before.
agentSettings.mcpIdle: Stopped (not connected). Declarations can be edited in the mcp.json tab and connect on startup.
agentSettings.mcpEmpty: No per-servant server declarations (add them in the mcp.json tab).
agentSettings.deleteMessage: Its configuration files (SKILL.md, Memory.md, mcp.json, icon) will also be removed. This cannot be undone.
agentSettings.discardMessage: Your edits will not be saved.

modelTemplate.title: Model templates
modelTemplate.idLockedHint: The identifier doubles as the credential key and as the reference servants point to, so it cannot be changed after creation.
modelTemplate.baseUrlMismatch: The selected protocol and the destination do not match. This configuration will always fail.
modelTemplate.keyPlaceholderStored: Paste a new key to overwrite
modelTemplate.keyStored: Registered. Stored in the OS credential store.
modelTemplate.keyMissing: No key registered. Requests will be rejected before sending as misconfigured and fall back to echo responses.
modelTemplate.authNotRequired: This endpoint needs no authentication (local inference server, etc.)
modelTemplate.toolCallsHint: When disabled, tool schemas are carried in the prompt instead
modelTemplate.googleSearchHint: Answers are grounded with Google Search first (can be combined with bundled tools and delegation)
modelTemplate.strandedStrong: it does nothing because the protocol is not Gemini
modelTemplate.strandedAfter: . Grounding exists only on the Gemini native path. To use it, set the protocol to Gemini native.
modelTemplate.keyStoreBefore: API keys are stored in the
modelTemplate.keyStoreAfter: (Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain / Secret Service). They are never written to configuration files, and there is no way to read them back into this screen. Only whether a key is registered can be shown.
modelTemplate.noSelection: Select from the list on the left, or create a new one with ＋.
modelTemplate.deleteKeyMessage: It will be removed from the OS credential store. Servants using this template will no longer be able to connect.
modelTemplate.deleteTemplateMessage: Servants referencing this template will not run until they are given another model.

schedule.title: Schedules (timed requests)
schedule.noticeIntro: Delivers a fixed request to a servant at a fixed time. Results appear in the conversation pane.
schedule.noticeLimit: Schedules do not run while the app is closed.
schedule.noticeCatchUp: Missed schedules are not run retroactively (interval schedules run once after restart).
schedule.empty: No schedules yet. Use the form below to choose which servant, what request, and when.
schedule.noAgents: No servants are registered, so there is no one to address. Create a servant in the left pane first.

session.title: Conversations
session.forkNoticeAfter: the chosen request, and puts that request's text back into the input box. Rewrite and send it to try a different phrasing. The original conversation is left untouched.
session.listNoticeIntro: Conversations persist across restarts. Reopen one and the servants answer with the earlier discussion in mind.
session.listNoticeLimit: Switching is only possible while no turn is in flight.
session.forkEmpty: There is nothing to fork from. Forking means going back to just before a request, so the very first request cannot be chosen (before it lies an empty conversation, which is the same as starting a new chat).
session.forkPointAction: Up to just before this request →
session.openTitle: Open this conversation (refused while a turn is in flight)
session.forkBtnTitle: Copy up to a point and try a different phrasing from there
session.exportTitle: Export as JSONL (the store is binary, so this is the readable way out)
session.deleteConfirmMessage: Its messages and histories cannot be recovered. If you want to keep it, export it first.

errors.DUPLICATE_AGENT_NAME: The display name is already in use by another servant
errors.MODEL_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: The model template is not registered

errors.LLM_API: The model API returned an error
